digest.component_or_area: review-bot auto-deploy and code review voting
propositions: auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, interrupting them and causing fail-closed LLM-Review -1 votes that block automatic recovery
the shutdown drain timeout (45s) is much shorter than the review timeout (1200s), causing reviews in progress to be killed before completion

retryable failures like review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, and gate-disabled should defer voting (leave change vote-less) to allow backfill reconciler re-drive instead of casting terminal -1 votes
the review_attempts ledger tracks consecutive retryable failures per (change_id, revision) and escalates to fail-closed -1 with marker after reaching the attempt cap
a genuinely concluded indeterminate or finding verdict must vote -1 (terminal), distinguishing from transient infrastructure failures that should be retried
the deferred path posts no vote and no provisional comment, keeping the change eligible for backfill reconciler re-drive
